title: The Song of the Ark: from Shiloh to Jerusalem
author: James Earle Patrick
sourceLocator: Appendix (9), p. 299 (PDF p. 313); full 41-element outline; chapter 3 analysis
note: Complete 41-element outline, not the author’s 11-element simplified rendition on p. 300. Source references use English chapter/verse numbering and explicitly give MT alternatives for 1 Samuel 21. All units retain the English references. Unit 7′ crosses the modern 1/2 Samuel division and is split into two book-specific anchors. Overlap between 2 Samuel 6:1–4 and 6:3–11 is present in the source and is retained. The author calls headings provisional signposts; the matching units are the passages themselves. The printed label for 19′ associates its stated 1 Samuel 21:1–9 boundary with a larger Keilah episode; ChiFold retains the stated boundary and flags the interpretive issue instead of altering the source range. Complete source outline. Reading alignment: verified; 0 of 41 elements currently lack a verified complete reading-edition mapping. Unmapped source coordinates never enter reader discovery.

nodes.title: Saul spares an enemy and tears a robe
David relieves Saul’s terror with music
God’s Spirit protects David from Saul
Philistine servants call David a king
David’s family and career enter exile
David’s future rule is affirmed in secret
David spares Saul and cuts his robe
Uzzah is judged beside the ark
